_comment: Values this paper superseded, and how many times each may still legitimately
appear. Traceability auditing cannot catch this: a superseded number and its
replacement both exist in the artifacts, so both 'trace' while the paper
contradicts itself. That happened twice -- once when the abstract was corrected
and the body was not, and once in reverse when the body moved to
execution-verified pairs and the abstract and contributions list did not.
'allowed' is the number of occurrences that are deliberate, normally because
the paper reports a before/after comparison. Exceeding it means a stale value

superseded.why: planted-effect ratio recomputed on 46 execution-verified pairs (DL-97); one mention remains in the before/after sentence
mean planted effect on verified pairs (DL-97); one mention in the before/after sentence
planted-effect spread on verified pairs (DL-97); one mention in the before/after sentence
code-first effect on verified pairs (DL-97)
third-person effect on verified pairs (DL-97)
AUROC spread at n=120 supersedes n=40 (DL-94); the n=40 value is retained in the comparison table on purpose

n=40 symmetrized Brier, legitimately reported in the polarity-bias comparison; NOT the retracted worse-than-constant claim. The check flagged it as ambiguous rather than stale, and the sentence now states its sample size.

Retired AS AN ASSAY-SENSITIVITY FLOOR (DL-98/DL-99): it was measured on the self-assessment task under a different question wording than the planted effect it was compared against. The matched floor is 0.2737. The value itself remains valid as the self-assessment channel's own SDC95 and is still reported that way, so the allowance is the count of those legitimate mentions -- any increase means the cross-instrument comparison has returned.
The matched floor from the 40-problem gauge, superseded by the 37-pair VERIFIED gauge (DL-102). Right instrument, wrong parts: its mutants were never graded and 3 of 40 still passed.
Mean planted effect on the unverified 40-problem gauge; superseded by the 37 execution-verified pairs (DL-102).
Attributed to other-code judging but never measured on it; the only 0.769 in any artifact is a self-assessment per-phrasing AUROC (DL-103). The verified other-code value is 0.7765.
